headline: Fantasy hockey trade suggestions: Guide to the luckiest and unluckiest shooters
take:
ESPN's fantasy desk went looking for the luckiest and unluckiest shooters this week, and our numbers point the same way on four names.

Mark Scheifele has 3 goals on 6.74 expected (chance quality) after 36 last season; gaps like that usually close. Juraj Slafkovsky is the same story, 2 goals on 5.66 expected and among the hardest shots in the league. Patrick Kane, 1 goal on 3.12, is less clear-cut: Chicago has taken just 35.47% of the expected goals with him on at 5-on-5, so the bounce may be smaller.

Logan Cooley is the flip side. He has 11 goals on 6.01 expected, and 14 of his 21 points have come on the power play. Our form check still calls his hot run earned, because the chances are real. The finishing rate is the part that won't last.
